//: D4 (agent-in-the-loop): automate dependency bumps so an agent evaluates them, never blind-merges. Requires enabling the Renovate GitHub App on this repo. D9: helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests rewrites every workflow `uses: x@vN` to `x@<sha> # vN` and keeps the digests current, because release.yml runs third-party actions beside TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY and a moved tag would run new code there.

packageRules.description: Safe, low-risk updates can auto-merge once CI (incl. the .ai conformance gate) is green.
Minor/major bumps open a PR for an agent + human to evaluate (changelog, breaking changes).
Cargo (Rust) updates are reviewed manually — cargo-deny already gates supply chain on every PR.
